incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service hosted-inference-prod at 2026-03-15T02:15:34Z (page id: PD-24567). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-inference-latency

incidentbot: Primary oncall <@alex> was paged at 02:15:34Z and did not ack within 2m — auto-escalating to secondary <@sara>.

alex: On a call, will be 5-10m. can someone pick this up? :phone: (can't ack right now)

sara: I'm awake, grabbing it. joining the bridge in 30s.

incidentbot: Escalation to manager if no ack within 5m. 

(After 5m)

incidentbot: No ack from secondary after 5m — escalating to manager <@kate>.

kate: Got page, grabbing details. opening bridge now: https://zoom.us/j/999999

mike: Observed 500 responses from frontend -> inference for ~3min. spike at 02:14:xx. rolling errors in logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:14:52Z INF client.go:145 token fetch timeout
2026-03-15T02:15:01Z ERR serving/runtime.go:987 kv cache miss heavy
```

anjali: Looking at hosts in us-west-2 serving-hosted-inference: a host shows OOM events and high latency. suspect a bad model rollout if recent -> checking deploy history.

sara: I can reroute traffic to dedicated pool brpool-01 to keep latency low. if we can start that now, buys time while infra investigates.

kate: Do it. mike/anjali coordinate. I'll notify CS + product. status-bot, post incident status: "Investigating - latency spikes impacting a subset of customers".

status-bot: Posted to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-24567 (investigating)

mike: Reroute command:
```
# switch route to brpool-01
redwoodctl routing set --service hosted-inference-prod --route brpool-01 --weight 1.0
```

mike: Done. traffic shift completes ~20s. monitoring.

sara: Observability: p50 p90 p99 dropping back to baseline within 1m. errors reduced from 11% -> 0.7% after shift.

anjali: Isolate host and drain kube node k8s-host-12 for postmortem. k8s events show oom-killer.

kate: Good. Customer impact: estimated 10% of production requests saw elevated latencies and 3% saw 5xx over a 3m window. No data loss reported. CS: starting outreach to 3 customers in top-tier list.

alex: Back now, acked the page and joining bridge. thanks for taking over.

sara: no problem. quick root cause: a model variant with a miscompiled kernel triggered memory regression when sequence length > 1024. rollback the model to v2.9 while infra confirms.

mike: Rolling back model version:
```
redwoodctl models deploy --service hosted-inference-prod --model llm-large:v2.9 --strategy immediate
```

mike: Rollback complete. verifying.

sara: Metrics look stable. keeping bridge 30m for soak and then will close.

kate: Action items:
- anjali: collect heap dumps + logs from k8s-host-12
- mike: document routing command + rollback steps
- sara: follow up with model-onboarding team about kernel compile tests
- alex: update oncall playbook with escalation timing note

anjali: I'll grab the artifacts and upload to the incident folder: /incidents/PD-24567/artifacts

kate: Thanks team. we'll do a brief RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll assign severity P2.

sara: closing bridge now. will post final update once RCA scheduled. :thumbsup:

incidentbot: Incident thread closed by <@kate> at 02:42:14Z. Duration ~27m.

(reacted :eyes: :thumbsup:)
